get.summary: audit log, including actor_name and metadata. filter with q (summary, action, entity, actor, metadata), since and until (date or RFC 3339), actor, action, entity_type, entity_id. sort=created_at for oldest first

post.summary: RFC 8628 device authorization for pursuit auth login --device. scope is space or comma separated, each exactly read or write, default read write; anything else (approve, APPROVE, Read) is invalid_scope: OAuth never grants approve. client_id is at most 64 characters. limited to 10 starts a minute per client IP (429 slow_down). device codes last 10 minutes; poll /v1/auth/token no faster than interval. there is no verification_uri_complete: the human types the code

get.summary: sign-in options: tenant_mode, providers, allow_token_login, demo_available

post.summary: RFC 7009 token revocation. holding the token is the authority; unknown tokens still return 200. pursuit auth logout calls this

OAuth2 token endpoint. grant_type=authorization_code takes code, code_verifier (PKCE S256), redirect_uri, client_id; codes are single-use and last 60 seconds. grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code takes device_code, client_id and answers authorization_pending, slow_down, expired_token, or access_denied until approved. The access_token is a normal pst_ API token

get.summary: start an OIDC sign-in; redirects to the provider

post.summary: run up to 100 API requests in order as the caller. body {requests:[{method,path,body,idempotency_key}],stop_on_error}. returns {results:[{status,body}],failed}. scopes apply per item, X-Dry-Run applies to every item, items are not atomic, and stop_on_error ends results at the first failure. Idempotency-Key goes on each item, not the batch

patch.summary: set display name or avatar (png, jpeg, or webp data URL under 256KB; empty clears it). email is accepted only from the PURSUIT_TRUST_PROXY_AUTH owner (GET /v1/me returns proxy: true)

get.summary: validate a loopback request for the dashboard /authorize page without deciding it. query client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method, state, scope (response_type is accepted and ignored). requires the approve scope. returns {client_id, scopes, redirect_uri} as the server normalized them; a scope other than read or write is 400 invalid_scope

post.summary: loopback consent, called by the dashboard /authorize page that pursuit auth login opens. requires a signed-in human session with the approve scope (not the PURSUIT_TRUST_PROXY_AUTH owner), Content-Type application/json, and Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin or an Origin matching the host. writes an oauth.approve or oauth.deny audit entry. body {client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge, code_challenge_method:S256, state, scope, approve}. redirect_uri must be http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback or http://[::1]:<port>/callback. returns {redirect_to}: the callback with code and state, or error=access_denied when approve is false

get.summary: look up a pending device login by user_code (query) so the dashboard can show the requested scopes. requires the approve scope. returns {user_code, client_id, scopes, status, created_at, expires_at}

post.summary: approve or deny a device login from the dashboard /device page. body {user_code, approve}. requires a signed-in human session with the approve scope (not the PURSUIT_TRUST_PROXY_AUTH owner), Content-Type application/json, and Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin or an Origin matching the host; the code alone approves nothing. writes an oauth.approve or oauth.deny audit entry. returns {status: approved|denied}
